name: J8 Series
summary: Full-colour, multi-material PolyJet realism for design teams.

page.description: Stratasys J8 Series 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Challenge meets
page.lead: The J8 Series (J850 Pro, J850 Prime and J826 Prime) prints up to seven materials in one job, from rigid to rubber-like and opaque to transparent, with PANTONE-validated colour.
page.footnote: PANTONE validation applies to colour-capable models. Source: stratasys.com J8 Series pages, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: One family, from functional to full colour.

features.title: Up to seven materials
features.text: Flexible to rigid and opaque to transparent in one model.

features.title: Multiple print modes
features.text: High Quality for detail, Super High Speed for drafts.
